_comment: Construções de província. level: nível de assentamento exigido (village, town, city). income: ouro por turno. growth: crescimento da população (%/turno). happiness: ordem pública. research: pesquisa por turno. defense: bônus do defensor na batalha (%). garrison: batalhões de guarnição a mais. recruits: libera batalhões (construção do jogo: barracks, range, stable, elephant_stable, market, fortress). xp: experiência inicial dos recrutados. walls: muralha na batalha (stone ou palisade).

buildings.name: Farmland
buildings.description: Fields and granaries: faster population growth and a little income.

buildings.name: Barracks
buildings.description: Trains the civilisation's regular infantry battalions.

buildings.name: Market
buildings.description: Trade income. Mercenary battalions can be hired here.

buildings.name: Palisade
buildings.description: A wooden palisade with a gate around the settlement.

buildings.name: Watchtower
buildings.description: Vigilance: one more garrison battalion and a defensive bonus.

buildings.name: Siege Workshop
buildings.description: Builds rams, catapults and bolt shooters for the army.

buildings.name: Port
buildings.description: Sea trade for a coastal province.

buildings.name: Stone Walls
buildings.description: Stone walls with towers and gates: assaults need siege engines (or a long siege), and the defenders hold the town much better.

buildings.name: Elephant Stables
buildings.description: War elephants, for the civilisations that have them.

buildings.name: Fortress
buildings.description: Champions, elite guards and a mighty garrison.
